en.Motifs, inversions mobiles et compteurs: Patterns, moving inversions and available ECC counters.
en.Calculs parallèles comparés à des répons: Parallel calculations checked against known answers.
en.Les traductions sont incluses dans l’app: Translations are included in the app. No translation service is contacted.
en.25 langues · dates et nombres localisés: 25 languages · local dates and numbers · right-to-left support
en.RAM, disques, processeur : faites le poi: RAM, drives, processor: check the components
that keep your everyday life running.
en.Tester la mémoire avant le lancement du: Test memory before the system starts
en.Activé par défaut : RAM, CPU et GPU. Les: Enabled by default: RAM, CPU and GPU. Changes take effect after saving preferences.
en.Après le test, réactivez Secure Boot dan: After the test, re-enable Secure Boot in UEFI settings. Do not erase firmware keys or reset your PC settings.
en.Aucune clé USB compatible trouvée. Branc: No compatible USB drive found. Connect and mount a FAT32 drive, then try again.
en.Avant toute modification, conservez votr: Before changing anything, keep your recovery key if your disk uses encryption, including BitLocker or TPM unlocking. Changing Secure Boot may require this key. On a managed PC, contact your administrator.
en.CPU et RAM : actualisation toutes les 2: CPU and RAM update every 2 seconds. GPU updates take up to 6 seconds depending on the driver. “—” means unavailable, rather than 0%.
en.Choisissez et confirmez le prochain test: Choose and confirm the next pre-boot test in the assistant.
en.Clé USB préparée. Vous pouvez maintenant: USB drive prepared. You can now safely eject it.
en.Comment débloquer le test avant démarrag: How can I enable the pre-boot test?
en.Consultez le guide de votre modèle de PC: Check your PC model’s guide to open UEFI settings and find out whether Secure Boot can be temporarily disabled. Computy does not change this setting.
en.Fermer la fenêtre conserve les indicateu: Closing the window keeps the indicators running in the background. Each indicator’s menu can reopen Computy, open preferences or quit the app completely.
en.Le GPU dépend des compteurs exposés par: GPU readings depend on your driver: AMD/NVIDIA on Linux, Windows performance counters and some IOAccelerator drivers on macOS. Unsupported GPUs remain unavailable.
en.Le test en session reste disponible sans: The in-session test remains available without changing firmware settings. It checks part of your RAM, rather than all physical memory.
en.Les mesures en direct sont indisponibles: Live measurements are unavailable. Computy retries automatically.
en.Linux : le bureau doit prendre en charge: Linux desktops need AppIndicator/StatusNotifier support. GNOME may require a supporting extension. Windows may place indicators in its hidden-icons menu.
en.L’aperçu utilise les mesures du moteur R: This preview uses measurements from the Rust engine. System tray icons are available in the installed Tauri app.
en.Secure Boot protège le démarrage en auto: Secure Boot protects startup by allowing only programs trusted by your PC. The test engine bundled with Computy has no signature trusted by your firmware, so this pre-boot test is blocked with or without a USB drive. This does not indicate a RAM fault.
en.Si vous choisissez cette option, revenez: If you choose this option, return to Computy after restarting and click “Check compatibility again”. Test preparation will still require your confirmation.
en.Test avant démarrage bloqué par Secure B: Pre-boot test blocked by Secure Boot
en.Un anneau par indicateur, visible même l: One ring per indicator, visible even when the window is hidden.
en.Un indicateur par volume sélectionné : l: One indicator per selected volume: the ring shows used space; its menu also shows read and write rates. These are usage measurements, not health scores.
en.Une clé USB utilise le même moteur et ne: A USB drive uses the same engine and has the same requirement. The original engine’s certificates do not validate Computy’s modified binary.
en.Vérification terminée : consultez les co: Check complete: review the requirements above.
en.Tous les processus accessibles, sans lim: All accessible processes, without a limit. Search by name or PID to find a process.
en.CPU : part de la capacité totale du proc: CPU: share of total processor capacity. RAM: resident memory and share of physical RAM; shared pages may be counted more than once. Protected processes may hide their measurements.
en.Disques : les débits par processus conce: Disk: per-process rates cover all volumes; percentages show each process’s share of observable I/O, not disk capacity usage. GPU: NVIDIA compute-process memory appears when supplied by the driver; this list does not cover all graphics processes or measure their GPU load.
